_meta.title: Aurora Pre-Outcome Pressure Map
_meta.generated_for: AURORA DREAM SUBSTRATE, FAIL-STREAM, POSITIVE-AFFECT, DEVELOPMENTAL WRITEBACK, AND NATIVE INTERMEDIATE RESOLUTION DIRECTIVE
_meta.core_requirement: P_pre (pressure before the mistake is known) must be captured and distinguished from P_post (pressure generated by discovering the mistake).

existing_pressure_producers_audited.reason_not_used: Ambient system-wide pressure, not scoped to a single interpretation/action's own prediction.
Same as above -- ambient, not response-scoped.
Note: DER = Energy Regulator, not a 'Developmental Evidence Record' -- no such record type exists. Ambient, not response-scoped.
Only reachable from consciousness.tick(), which is not wired into the live per-turn pipeline (confirmed by audit) -- would require new wiring beyond this pass's scope to make it turn-scoped.
By construction only populated at the moment a subsystem confesses it cannot resolve something -- i.e. already a post-detection snapshot.

existing_pressure_producers_audited.reason_used: The ONE place in the codebase where a full multi-axis pressure state is unambiguously computed BEFORE any error-detection code can run (_evaluate_previous_accuracy only runs on the NEXT turn). Already had a producer (_pressure_from_state, already used identically by _record_genealogy_event) and an existing consumer/carrier (pending_validation, already read back cross-turn by _evaluate_previous_accuracy) -- textbook Repair Authority case.

repair.capture_point: before_state (captured at method entry, before meaning/boundary/cost/policy states are derived), converted via the pre-existing _pressure_from_state()
repair.storage: pending_validation['pre_outcome_pressure'] (new key, added alongside the existing response_id/expected_topic/expected_axis fields already used for cross-turn validation)
repair.consumer_function: _evaluate_previous_accuracy() -- now surfaces pending.get('pre_outcome_pressure') in its return dict
repair.binding_function: _record_pre_outcome_fail_if_applicable() (new, called from ingest_observation right after _evaluate_previous_accuracy) -- binds the captured pressure to a FailPointLedger.rich_stream event ONLY when the verdict genuinely indicates a correction/confusion (label in {'corrected', 'expression_unclear'})
repair.repair_authority_basis: Criterion 1 (existing producer: before_state/_pressure_from_state already computed for genealogy logging), criterion 2 (existing consumer: pending_validation already the cross-turn carrier _evaluate_previous_accuracy already reads), criterion 3 (missing wiring -- the value existed but was discarded), criterion 4 (no new semantics: nothing decides what P_pre means, only preserves and relays it).

pre_vs_post_distinction.pre_outcome_pressure: Captured once, at commit_application() time, stored verbatim in pending_validation, never recomputed.
pre_vs_post_distinction.post_error_pressure: Whatever _pressure_from_state(self.state) would compute AFTER the correction is recognized on the next turn -- the contract's live state has moved on by then. Verified distinct in tests/test_preoutcome_pressure_capture.py::TestPreErrorAndPostErrorPressureAreDistinguished.
pre_vs_post_distinction.substitution_guard: The rich-stream event's pre_outcome_pressure field is populated exclusively from the accuracy dict's carried-over value, never from a fresh _pressure_from_state(self.state) call at correction-detection time.

fail_domain_separation.corpus_rubric_domain: FailPointLedger.record_fail() (existing, dimension-keyed, drives curriculum targeting) -- inherently retrospective, no pre-outcome concept applies, pre_outcome_pressure is always None on this path.
fail_domain_separation.live_conversational_domain: FailPointLedger.record_pre_outcome_event() (new) -- feeds ONLY the rich stream, never _records/fail_count/severity_sum/get_top_fails, to avoid conflating live user-correction signal with corpus/rubric dimension weakness.
